cases.answer: Canvas SessionGroup IDs identify attendees; persisted groups identify members. Conversion copies each group and resolves attendees via explicit memberId. String ID resolves only that member, null means unregistered, deleted stored ID never rematches a namesake. Only undefined enables isSameName plus full/two-digit student-prefix matching; prefix miss uses first same-name member. Failed resolution preserves attendee ID. Meeting start rejects assigned unregistered people first and stores member-bound snapshots.

cases.answer: DailyPlannings is an operating snapshot with versions, separate from confirmed sessions. Meeting start preserves an existing confirmed record. Rename transaction reads current planning and valid linked session, independently maps current groups and changes only name, preserving games/notes/members/other groups and top-level fields. Missing linked record fails before writes; invalid/absent link edits only planning; removed confirmed groups are not recreated. Planning restore/delete leaves confirmed history alone. Session deletion batches detachment of queried plans, session deletion and audit. Session editor merges unchanged groups from latest read and retains board snapshot.
cases.graphFinding: Exact explain shows EXTRACTED meeting-progress -> rename calls, rename -> archive/audit calls and rename -> both collection shares_data_with edges. Documentation planning/confirmed reference is INFERRED. Current source supplies preservation semantics beyond signatures.
limits: Rename transaction can retry on read-document changes; mocked tests do not demonstrate real multi-client retries.
Session/game writers use getDoc then batch, so later concurrent writes can still be overwritten. Merge preserves only edits visible at read time and untouched editor groups.
Edited groups can replace concurrent fields in the same group; initialGroups=null uses edited array.
Deletion queries links before the batch; newly linked plans may escape detachment. No global concurrency guarantee.

cases.answer: Registered admins and bootstrap/stored master manage interview data; admin-management privileges differ. Public clients fetch exact active bearer token with safe summary; missing exact token allows invalid-link UI, inactive token/listing denied. Public writes constrain first-access/response keys, server timestamps, survey window and unique allowed slots; identity/admin fields cannot change. Active public configuration exact GET requires no token; list/write is admin-only. Client undefined scheduleId uses legacy round, null stays unassigned without legacy fetch, ID uses schedule plus common round. Migration accepts undefined legacy applicants only. Rules normalize absence/null/non-string scheduleId to null and allow legacy response fallback, unlike client null semantics.
